🌿 The Moment of Choice — Eden
📖 Genesis 3:6

When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly.
I see the fruit lifted… the pause before the choice… the weight of silence in Eden.
Nothing looks broken yet—but everything feels fragile.

I’m not part of the moment, yet I feel its echo.
How easily desire bends trust.
How quietly a single decision reshapes everything.

As I witness this, I ask myself—
where do my own small choices begin to drift my heart?
💭 Share what this moment stirs in you.
What emotion do you notice first as you witness this moment—curiosity, fear, or longing?
Why do you think the choice unfolds so quietly rather than dramatically?
Where in your life do small decisions feel more significant than they appear?
What helps you pause before reaching for what looks “good” but may cost more?
